framework_lessons: Distinguish business recovery from security pricing.
assessment: The travel-recovery thesis is strongly supported, while the named twelve-month IEF hedge lost money. Gold's 2023 relative result depends on the endpoint and is reported that way. The deferred oil contract again failed at its explicit maturity. Several three-year directional sector views worked through broad ETF proxies, with uneven relative results. The human-rights discussion establishes real use cases but overstates what an adoption index measures and cannot establish universal access or safety.
verification_limitations: Captured website text is not an authenticated publication-date version.
Chart-only numerical claims have not been visually verified.
Selected stock/ETF adjusted-close comparisons are disclosed where used; no reconstructed portfolio backtest has been performed.
Unresolved verdicts are not forecast failures or successes; no aggregate hit rate is inferred.
